content.text:
Build passes with no errors. Here is a summary of what was done:

### Changes made

**`components/sidebar.tsx`** — Major rewrite:
- Sidebar width changed from 220px to 180px
- Menu consolidated from 8 items to 5: "채용현황", "후보자 관리", "데이터 관리" (main section) + "권한 관리", "사용자 관리" (시스템 section)
- DEAN_MENU reduced to 2 items: "채용현황" and "후보자 관리"
- Removed unused icon imports (`Table2`, `ArrowRightLeft`, `ListChecks`); added `Menu` and `X` for hamburger
- Added `useEffect`-based mobile detection at `max-width: 767px`
- Mobile mode renders a fixed 48px top bar with logo + hamburger toggle, and a full-screen overlay menu when open
- Menu item clicks auto-close the mobile menu via `onItemClick` callback
- Extracted `MenuContent`, `LogoBlock`, and `DeanDepartmentInfo` as shared sub-components used in both mobile and desktop modes
- `UserMenu` works in both modes without changes

**`app/layout.tsx`** — Replaced inline `style={{ marginLeft: 220, ... }}` on `<main>` with `className="main-content"`.

**`app/globals.css`** — Added `.main-content` class with `margin-left: 180px` and a `@media (max-width: 767px)` responsive rule that removes the left margin and adds 48px top margin for the mobile header bar.
